title: Certify general position from all maximal Vandermonde minors

source.citation: Ralf Gerkmann, Mao Sheng, and Kang Zuo, Computational details on the disproof of modularity, arXiv:0709.1054

translation.notes: The displayed 4-by-8 matrix is entered from the paper's embedded Magma calculation. Noether computes every maximal minor, while the independent Vandermonde product formula checks each result. The later invariant Jacobian-ring and Higgs computations are outside this scoped case.
